description:
pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:544-548

  Ok(delta_crl
      .tbs_cert_list
      .revoked_certificates
      .clone()
      .unwrap_or_default())

This clones the entire revoked_certificates Vec<RevokedCert> to return it. The function signature returns Vec<RevokedCert> (owned), and the CertificateList is borrowed. The clone is necessary because the caller needs ownership and we're borrowing from delta_crl.

However, the calling code in check_revocation (lines 288-323) already re-borrows delta_crl entries only for comparison. An alternative design would pass a callback or return a slice reference rather than cloning. For typical CRL sizes (dozens to low thousands of entries), the clone is not a practical problem, but it is worth noting as a future optimization target if large CRLs become common.

This is a structural inefficiency rather than an anti-pattern. Not a high-priority fix but worth tracking.
title: [rusty] pkix-revocation crl.rs: verify_delta_crl_and_collect clones revoked_certificates unnecessarily
